title: Skynet has entered sleep mode.
description: A red-eyed hockey robot tucks a sleeping monkey into a royal bed. The monkey has a jester hat, monkey pajamas, and a stuffed monkey for backup.

title: Customer support has escalated the ticket.
description: IR BOB leans on a rocket launcher while a chrome hockey robot crashes through an arena screen flashing SYSTEM FAILURE.
